decisions.subject: Owned ContactInfo
decisions.rule: Person, Company and Branch each own independent ContactInfo collections of ContactPoint values; no direct customer phone/email/address fields; reusable Customer Domain component, not a separate microservice.

decisions.subject: Dynamic contact types
decisions.rule: System plus Tenant-customizable type catalog with stable identity, unique code, multilingual titles, supported value type, declarative validation rules, applicability, multiplicity, status and order; supported new types configurable without product release.

decisions.subject: Typed contact values
decisions.rule: Typed values with distinct phone, email, website and address shapes; select supported validation capabilities, no unrestricted arbitrary executable tenant rules.

decisions.subject: Historical preservation
decisions.rule: Type modification or deactivation does not delete historical contact data; original Tenant and Audit requirements preserved.

decisions.subject: Multilingual direction
decisions.rule: Persian and English initially, extensible languages, selectable UI locale, translation keys for messages, localized catalog labels and suitable multilingual facts; stable language-independent codes.

decisions.subject: Presentation settings
decisions.rule: RTL/LTR, calendar, number/date formatting and timezone independently configurable; canonical dates and identities unchanged.

openContracts: primary groups, replacement, removal and defaults
type applicability, multiplicity defaults, usage labels, code namespace, normalization, reuse and lifecycle
translation requirements, fallback, localized historical labels and customer fact eligibility
supported value shapes, validation descriptors, normalization, country and legal issuer contracts
storage, version, concurrency, IAM, disclosure, Audit and retention
GraphQL and events architecture alignment, locale negotiation and presentation contracts

criteria.expected: Multiple type-referenced ContactPoints, no direct channel fields
No implicit owner sharing; mismatch rejected locally
Reject incompatible, inactive or inapplicable new type; retain history
Multiple contacts and primary selection subject to approved grouping
Optional fields, no implicit verification or uniqueness
